links.comparator_used: Standard of care: historically suspected and diagnosed AHP cases retrieved from the hospital records, with specialist review of plausibility
links.outcome: Rate of clinically plausible cases (precision) and number of de-novo plausible cases
links.effect: 74 of 191 (38.74%) HAI cases were clinically plausible vs 28 of 107 (27.72%) SOC cases. 46 of the 74 plausible HAI cases were de-novo cases missed by SOC. The difference in precision was not statistically significant.
links.quote: In our study, our proposed HAI screening approach showed a higher plausibility rate in suspected cases compared to the SOC and statistical testing could not find a statistically significant difference between the screening methods.

design_hint: human-in-the-loop physician triage of AI screening output
